assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original medieval quest-space pixel-art REVIEW board with TWO separate simple cutaway spaces side by side. Reference image supplies ONLY muted brown grey olive stone/timber materials and rustic border settlement mood. COARSE crisp pixel clusters, top-down oblique ORTHOGRAPHIC square-grid paving, walls horizontal and posts vertical, no diamond isometric. LEFT ordinary roadside care eave outside military gate: two SEPARATE small cup cabinets, military plain dark cups and civilian earthware cups, separate blank limited observation tags on wall, simple care bench, clean supply approach on left and patient approach on right BOTH reach common public road. RIGHT independent civilian short-stay room with EXACTLY TWO narrow beds, two bed tally tokens, personal bundle beside each, plain waiting bench without nameplates. One bed represents one body, no cloned patients. All spaces unoccupied, no research device. Broad open civilian door faces public road, never through military gate, bedroom or laboratory; no locked common gate. Care is available independently of research consent, show no signatures, names, text or labels. Empty beds are conceptual placement not additional inventory. Modest low shelter, partial roof cutaway, no castle panoramic map, no glowing magic. Keep floors square-axis and props sparse/readable, not painterly illustration. No labels, text, watermark.
assets.qa: Two separate cup cabinets and civilian two-bed room rendered; care eave has open front, lodging has independent street door. Left eave adds cushioned chairs; these are seats, not extra beds. New D01 board complements existing 47 single-bed N7 care room without replacing it. Fine textures and nonuniform pixel clusters remain; no native grid/palette verification.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval quest-space pixel-art review board, TWO sparse adjacent cutaways separated by plain gutter. Use reference ONLY for rough stone, brown timber and muted olive grey roadside border mood, no panoramic town. Coarse square pixel clusters, top-down oblique ORTHOGRAPHIC horizontal walls vertical posts, square-axis ground, no diamond perspective. LEFT windbreak grain-weighing shed: TWO distinct wooden measuring grain tubs side by side under SAME roof and mutually visible, one visibly less full; modest sack rack with clear EMPTY bay, small wooden household shortfall tally set separately. No overflowing reserves. Wide public pedestrian route OUTSIDE shed along front, unloading route along its outer left edge, neither crosses scales. RIGHT wage-disbursement arcade: small closed wage escrow cabinet with public-facing retrieval counter, separate rectangular stop-work basic-wage tokens in tray, rough stone sample with mason's cut marks representing work ALREADY done, a separate untouched future-shift board with BLANK slot. Keep coins modest and limited, no handover action, no people, no signed renewal. Open street-facing entrances to BOTH spaces, no checkpoint locking workers inside. Scene demonstrates grain shortfall and already-earned wage bookkeeping distinct, does not claim any payment or road completion. No written words, labels, numbers, royal crest, magic, portraits or watermark.
assets.qa: Two mutually visible measuring bins differ in fill, empty shelf bay and public approach remain. Wage cabinet, distinct tally tray and worked stone are separate from grain. Renderer added horse-cart on side lane; no narrative event. Square paving visible but load capacities and actual payments are not established.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO modest original medieval quest locations side by side, pixel-art REVIEW only. Same muted stone timber olive materials as reference, greatly simplified COARSE crisp pixel clusters and square-axis top-down oblique orthographic perspective, no diamond isometric, no panoramic fortress. LEFT finite military-civilian exchange hall cutaway: short grain shelf on left, short equipment/ordinary-medicine shelf on right, both mostly sparse with distinctly EMPTY arrival bays. Simple central counter has SEPARATE limited wooden grain and medicine tokens, not treasury. Open civilian exit at front-right directly to street, never through armed formation. RIGHT small LETTER RETURN ALCOVE open to civilian road, stone cubby holds exactly ONE CLOSED folded wax-sealed personal letter, original NOT delivered yet. In separate little trays, one blank personal stay/leave token and one worn proxy-expiry tally with simple notch; these are not signatures or consent. Plain stool and small lamp, space for private conversation, no addresses exposed. No duplicate original letter, no displayed readable message, no envelopes flying toward family, no promise of returned traveler or continued job. Broad open street door, no prison bars, no guards, no characters. Props distinguish exchange stock, family communication and job choice, don't imply transaction complete. No text labels, numbers, heraldry, magic or watermark.
assets.qa: Sparse grain and medical/tool shelves, empty bays, independent open street exit and exactly one sealed original letter in cubby. Two separate decision/expiry trays present. Requested grain/medicine tokens rendered as actual sample goods, and proxy tally resembles tied slats; these are visual prop proposals not inventory or authorization evidence. No delivered letter implied.
